messages:
maria: Auditor asked for evidence showing the RBAC consolidation impact on KMS keys (svc-* -> role/platform-service). Need signed bundle + chain-of-custody today.

ajay: Acknowledged. Which artifacts do they want exactly? PR diff, policy diffs, key access logs, and a signed manifest?

maria: Yes — 1) PR and approval record, 2) exact policy diff, 3) CloudTrail/KMS slice proving only intended principals accessed keys, 4) manifest+KMS signature, 5) one-line chain-of-custody CSV.

lee: I can pull the CloudTrail slice for 2026-02-09..2026-02-11 and filter KMS:GenerateDataKey/Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign and IAM:AttachRolePolicy/PutRolePolicy/AssumeRole. Will export to s3 and redact hostnames per auditor (keep ARNs/principals).

nina: Found PR infra/iam#4123; approver @ajay, sec review @maria, JIRA SEC-982. I'll attach pr-4123-diff.txt and the approval thread snapshot.

auditor-sam: Please normalize timestamps to UTC and include a small human-readable mapping: policy-diff -> affected key ARNs -> principals added/removed. Also include a short statement (2 lines) about CVE-2026-0123 correlation window 2026-02-09..2026-02-11.

ajay: For signing I will create manifest.json with file list and SHA256s, then sign with alias/audit-signing-key. Example command (compact):
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-signing-key --message fileb://manifest+digests.txt --message-type RAW --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA256 --query Signature --output text | base64 --decode > manifest.sig

lee: Export job started: export-20260210-ct-99 (deploy-bot). I'll tag run IDs in the slice. Initial run shows only expected GenerateDataKey spikes from svc-infer-batch at 2026-02-10T03:12Z (run-8812). No ERROR-level KMS responses.

maria: Also tie this to INF-721 (CVE triage). Auditor wants a 2-line confirmation if any keys were implicated.

lee: Triage note: no anomalous key usage during the window. The GenerateDataKey spike maps to scheduled jobs; attached job IDs and container IDs for auditors to verify.

nina: Preparing chain-of-custody CSV (timestamp, filename, action, actor) and will include PR approval row. Redacting hostnames only.

auditor-sam: Good. One more: provide a brief description of policy-eval method (2-3 sentences) — what tool/command you used to prove no external principals.

ajay: I'll add policy-eval.txt: we diffed key policy JSONs and ran internal iam-policy-sim against each key ARN to list allowed principals; sample command and output included.

lee: Upload complete: s3://redwood-auditor-exports/2026-02-10/ct-kms-slice.json (12.1MB).

maria: Assembling evidence-bundle-20260210.tar.gz (ct slice, pr-4123-diff.txt, policy-eval.txt, coc.csv, manifest+sig). Will upload and share presigned 7d link.

auditor-sam: Thanks — after signature verification, please paste the exact policy diff snippet showing the platform-service allow statements into the bundle. That helps our control mapping.

nina: Added pr-4123-diff.txt with explicit allow for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/platform-service and removed svc-infer-* statements.

maria: Bundle uploaded; presigned link (7d TTL) posted to the auditor. Signature verified by auditor-sam. Closing unless they reopen. :white_check_mark:
